description: This file defines functions and an exported async function to handle resetting model overrides in a session context, including parsing input, resolving model references, and updating session data.

methods.name: splitBody
methods.description: Splits a string body into tokens and extracts the first two tokens.

methods.name: buildSelectionFromExplicit
methods.description: Builds a model selection object from explicit raw input, considering allowed model keys and default provider/model.

methods.name: applySelectionToSession
methods.description: Applies a model selection override to a session entry and updates session store if provided.

methods.name: applyResetModelOverride
methods.description: Main exported function that processes a reset model override request, parsing input, resolving model references, and updating session context.
